attempts.hypothesis: For this single-group full-attention workload, instruction count is driven by cached-prefix traversal and fixed branch costs for existing versus newly needed blocks.

pcvs.name: prefix_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Counts cached prefix blocks potentially inspected when determining allocation requirements.

pcvs.name: has_prefix_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Captures fixed overhead of handling a nonempty cached prefix.

pcvs.name: has_existing_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes initial allocation from requests with an existing block table.

pcvs.name: needs_additional_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Captures the branch where existing and prefix blocks cannot cover the requested token slots.

attempts.hypothesis: The observed workload has no prefix blocks and nearly constant query cost. Token extent provides sufficient distinct states, while existing-block status explains the small initial-allocation overhead.

pcvs.name: tokens_needing_slots
pcvs.rationale: The allocation query rounds this token extent into required blocks; its variation also supplies distinct entry states.

pcvs.name: has_existing_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Captures the initial-versus-existing allocation distinction associated with the measured instruction-count difference.

attempts.hypothesis: Token extent had a fitted coefficient of zero. Request-table cardinality is a more relevant source of distinct states for this nearly constant-cost query, potentially explaining bookkeeping variation alongside initial-versus-existing allocation.

pcvs.name: tracked_requests
pcvs.rationale: Measures the request-table size governing dictionary lookup and possible insertion or resizing costs.
